preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n-1 lines.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == final_y(i+1, a) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output corresponds to the final value of y for the sequence starting with i+1.
